basic_profile.bio: I'm a financial consultant from Milan, Italy, passionate about personal finance and tech. I enjoy helping people manage their money better and have been using various finance apps for over a decade. I'm a tech enthusiast, often found discussing the latest in PC builds and gaming. I'm married with two kids and love spending my weekends exploring new places with my family. My online activity peaks during the late evening hours after the kids are asleep or early in the morning. I work as a freelance financial advisor, allowing me flexibility in my schedule.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Economics from the University of Milan and over 15 years of experience in personal finance consulting. My interest in technology and finance led me to self-teach various finance software tools. I regularly attend workshops and webinars to stay updated on the latest trends in financial technology.
